findings.issue: `spaceTime.γ.Slash.{slash, slashProd, slash_zero, slash_add, slash_smul, slashProd_nil, slashProd_cons}` (lines 147-177) reproduce the exact member names of `Fermion.Dirac.Slash.*` in the pinned Physlib, on the same type (`Lorentz.Vector` has `d := 3` by default), with the same docstring 'The Dirac slash of a Lorentz vector' — but the local one is `∑ μ, coord k μ • γ μ` (contravariant components, no metric) while upstream's is `endEquivMatrix (gammaMatrix k)` = `k_μ γ^μ`. summary: The newly pinned Physlib now carries material that EpsilonEridani still exposes locally: `spaceTime.γ0_eq`–`γ3_eq` are verbatim duplicates of upstream `spaceTime.γ0_eq_matrix`–`γ3_eq_matrix`, and `spaceTime.γ.Slash.*` collides name-for-name with `Fermion.Dirac.Slash.*` while using a different index convention. Sixteen `*Extensions.lean` modules are also content-free forwarding imports of Physlib modules.
